systems.country_label: national cloud data centre; Cloud Project
systems.platform: Tier 3 data centre, built by Sybyl Limited
systems.owner: National Information Technology Authority - Uganda (NITA-U); World Bank funding under the Regional Communication Infrastructure Program
systems.tiers: sites in Kampala and Jinja; 57 government institutions hosted at launch on 2019-07-11, capacity 285; no local government office said to be on it

note: A news report of the launch of the government data centre at Jinja; the municipality is only the place of the launch. It hosts ministries, departments and agencies, and no local government office is said to be connected.
